explanation: I searched the four Mathlib files that mention GroupLike: Coalgebra/GroupLike, Bialgebra/GroupLike, HopfAlgebra/GroupLike and Bialgebra/MonoidAlgebra. Mathlib has `IsGroupLikeElem.map` for coalgebra homomorphisms. It has no bundled map on the `GroupLike` subtype, no monoid homomorphism `GroupLike R A →* GroupLike R B` induced by a bialgebra homomorphism, and no lemma saying its value is `f g.val`. `BialgHom.groupLikeMap` and `GroupLike.map` are defined in this library, so `groupLikeMap_val` has no Mathlib counterpart.
